members.name: DefaultLifetime
members.desc: Constant: singleton.

members.name: Container
members.desc: The container builder this binder registers into.

members.name: BoundTypes
members.desc: The contract types the result is registered as. Starts with `TContract`.

members.name: ResultType
members.desc: The concrete type resolved for the contract, set by `To`.

members.name: Lifetime
members.desc: The lifetime the registration uses.

members.name: HasEntryPoints
members.desc: Set when the result or a bound type is a VContainer entry point, so the entry point dispatcher gets registered.

members.name: RegistrationBuilder
members.desc: The builder registered with the container. It builds the final registration from this binder's settings.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `Binder` from `container`.

members.name: AsSingleton
members.desc: Registers with singleton lifetime (the default).

members.name: AsTransient
members.desc: Registers with transient lifetime, a new instance each time it is resolved.

members.name: AsScoped
members.desc: Registers with scoped lifetime.

members.name: And
members.desc: Also registers the result under another contract type.

members.name: To
members.desc: Sets the concrete type to resolve. The overload taking an instance registers that existing object instead.

members.name: To
members.desc: Sets the concrete type to resolve. The overload taking an instance registers that existing object instead.

members.name: BindToType
members.desc: Adds a contract type to the bound types if it isn't there yet.

members.name: RegisterAnyValidEntryPoints
members.desc: Checks the result type and bound types for entry point interfaces and binds any it finds. Called when the registration is built.

members.name: RegisterEntryPointInType
members.desc: Binds any VContainer entry point interfaces a type implements, and notes that entry points exist.

types.name: Binder<TContract>.AltaRegistrationBuilder
types.summary: VContainer registration builder used by `Binder<TContract>`. Builds the registration from the binder's types and lifetime, or from a bound instance.

members.name: instance
members.desc: Instance set by `BindToInstance`, or null.

members.name: instanceProvider
members.desc: Instance provider field. Not used in this class's code.

members.name: Binder
members.desc: The binder this builder reads its types and lifetime from.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `Binder` from `binder`.

members.name: BindToInstance
members.desc: Stores an instance so the registration always returns it.

members.name: Build
members.desc: Adds any entry point interfaces, makes sure the entry point dispatcher is registered if needed, then builds the registration.

members.name: BuildForInstance
members.desc: Builds a registration whose provider always returns the bound instance.

members.name: BuildForContract
members.desc: Builds a normal type registration bound to every contract type.

types.name: Binder<TContract>.AltaRegistrationBuilder.InstanceProvider
types.summary: VContainer instance provider that always returns one fixed object, used when a binding is made to an existing instance.

members.name: instance
members.desc: The object handed out.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `Binder` from `instance`.

members.name: SpawnInstance
members.desc: Returns the stored instance.

types.name: AltaMenuItem
types.summary: Base for Alta's editor menu commands. Subclasses nest inside an `AltaMenuItemBase` path class, and editor tooling generates a Unity menu entry for each one. Editor only, does nothing in a running server.

members.name: SubstringCount
members.desc: Length of the `AltaMenuItemBase` type name plus one, cut off the base type name to get the menu path.

members.name: Name
members.desc: Menu entry name. Defaults to the class name with spaces put before each capital letter.

members.name: Description
members.desc: Optional description for the tool search. Null unless overridden.

members.name: Icon
members.desc: Always `Icons/Command.png`.

members.name: Priority
members.desc: Menu ordering priority. Zero unless overridden.

members.name: Run
members.desc: What the menu item does when picked. Each subclass implements it.

members.name: Validate
members.desc: Whether the menu entry is enabled. True unless overridden.

members.name: GetArguments
members.desc: The parameter list written into the generated menu method, always a `UnityEditor.MenuCommand`.

members.name: Content
members.desc: Writes the body of the generated menu method, which by default just calls the item's run method.

members.name: ExternalContent
members.desc: Writes extra code outside the generated method. Empty by default.

members.name: GetPath
members.desc: Menu path, built from the base class's full name with the `AltaMenuItemBase` prefix removed, `_` turned to spaces and `+` to `/`.

members.name: GeneratePath
members.desc: Joins an item's path and cleaned name into the full menu path.

members.name: GeneratePathSplit
members.sig: static void GeneratePathSplit(ISearchableTool item, out string path, out string name)
members.desc: Splits an item into menu path and cleaned name, logging an error and stripping `%`, `#` and `&` if the name has them.

members.name: Run
members.desc: What the menu item does when picked. Each subclass implements it.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates an `AltaMenuItem` with default values.

types.name: AltaNetworkError
types.summary: Network errors a transport can report, such as DNS failure, timeout, congestion, bad send or receive, and closed connection.

types.name: INetworkTransportResult
types.summary: Result of a network transport operation such as a send or processing incoming packets.

members.name: IsSuccess
members.desc: True when the operation worked.

members.name: Error
members.desc: Error message when the operation failed.

types.name: IPacketProcessor
types.summary: Handles packets the network transport receives.

members.name: Process
members.sig: void Process(ITransportSocket socket, int connection, ArraySegment<byte> data, int channel)
members.desc: Handles one packet from a connection on the given socket and channel.

types.name: IParallelPacketProcessor
types.summary: An `IPacketProcessor` that may handle packets in parallel and can say how many it has not finished yet. Nothing implements it in this build.

members.name: UnResolvedPackets
members.desc: Number of packets still being handled.

types.name: ITransport
types.summary: A low-level network transport that `Socket` sends packets over. `KcpTransport` is the implementation in this build.

members.name: PacketSize
members.desc: Largest packet the transport sends, in bytes.

members.name: ByteOffset
members.desc: Bytes the transport reserves at the start of each packet for its own header.

members.name: CreateServer
members.desc: Starts listening for connections on a port.

members.name: Connect
members.desc: Opens a client connection to an IP address and port.

members.name: CreateChannel
members.desc: Creates a reliable or unreliable channel and returns its id.

members.name: Terminate
members.desc: Shuts the transport down.

types.name: ITransportClient
types.summary: Client side of a transport: one connection to a server. `ITransport.Connect` returns one.

members.name: Connection
members.desc: The connection to the server.

members.name: Approved
members.desc: Raised when the server accepts the connection.

members.name: Disconnected
members.desc: Raised when the connection drops.

types.name: ITransportConnection
types.summary: One player's connection on the server-side network transport (KCP in this build): send data, disconnect and read traffic counters.

members.name: Id
members.desc: Transport connection id.

members.name: OutgoingQueueSize
members.desc: Messages waiting in the send queue.

members.name: OutgoingBytesTotal
members.desc: Total bytes sent on this connection.

members.name: OutgoingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Total packets sent on this connection.

members.name: IsFlooded
members.desc: Whether the connection is overloaded. Always false for the KCP connection.

members.name: Disconnected
members.desc: Raised when the connection drops.

members.name: Send
members.sig: INetworkTransportResult Send(byte[] data, int byteCount, int highLevelChannel)
members.desc: Sends the first `byteCount` bytes on a channel. The KCP version overwrites byte 0 with the channel number.

members.name: Disconnect
members.desc: Closes the connection.

types.name: ITransportServer
types.summary: The listening side of a network transport, made by `ITransport.CreateServer`. Raises events as client connections come and go. The KCP transport's `KcpServerWrapper` implements it.

members.name: ConnectionCreated
members.desc: Raised when a new client connection is made.

members.name: ConnectionDestroyed
members.desc: Raised when a client connection is closed.

types.name: ITransportSocket
types.summary: A network socket in Alta's transport layer, with traffic counters and process calls. KCP client and server wrappers implement it.

members.name: OutgoingQueueSize
members.desc: How many outgoing messages are waiting to be sent.

members.name: OutgoingBytesTotal
members.desc: Count of bytes sent.

members.name: OutgoingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Count of packets sent.

members.name: IncomingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Count of packets received.

members.name: OnError
members.desc: Raised when the socket hits a transport error, as an `AltaNetworkError`.

members.name: CopyDataForCache
members.desc: Copies received bytes (skipping already-processed ones) into a pooled buffer, so packets can be queued after the receive buffer is reused.

members.name: ProcessIncoming
members.desc: Reads waiting incoming data and hands each packet to the given processor.

members.name: ProcessOutgoing
members.desc: Flushes queued outgoing data.

members.name: Terminate
members.desc: Shuts the socket down.

types.name: MessageReceivePool
types.summary: Thread-safe pool of 64 KB byte arrays for received network messages, so the receive path doesn't allocate a new buffer each time.

members.name: Logger
members.desc: NLog logger for this class.

members.name: Pool
members.desc: The `ConcurrentBag` holding free buffers.

members.name: MaximumMessageSize
members.desc: Size of every pooled buffer: 65535 bytes.

members.name: MaximumPoolSize
members.desc: Cap on pooled buffers (100). Buffers returned past it are dropped.

members.name: isMonitoring
members.desc: When true, the editor logs a warning on a full pool. Always false in this build.

members.name: Get
members.desc: Takes a buffer from the pool, or allocates a new 65535-byte array if it is empty.

members.name: Put
members.desc: Returns a buffer to the pool unless it already holds more than 100. Callers include the server packet receivers.

types.name: NetworkTransportResult
types.summary: Simple success or error result returned by transport calls such as `ProcessIncoming` and `Terminate`.

members.name: Success
members.desc: Shared successful result, returned by most transport calls.

members.name: NoResources
members.desc: Shared failed result with the message "No resources".

members.name: IsSuccess
members.desc: True when the call worked.

members.name: Error
members.desc: The error message; null on success.

members.name: FromError
members.desc: Makes a failed result with the given message.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `NetworkTransportResult` with default values.

types.name: KcpClientConnection
types.summary: Client: the `ITransportConnection` for the client's single KCP connection to the server.

members.name: transport
members.desc: The `KcpTransport`, used to map game channels to KCP channels.

members.name: client
members.desc: The kcp2k client.

members.name: OutgoingQueueSize
members.desc: Number of messages in the KCP send queue.

members.name: OutgoingBytesTotal
members.desc: Total bytes sent through `Send` (empty sends not counted).

members.name: OutgoingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Total packets sent through `Send` (empty sends not counted).

members.name: Id
members.desc: Always 0; the client has only one connection.

members.name: IsFlooded
members.desc: Always false for KCP.

members.name: Disconnected
members.desc: Raised by `OnDisconnected` when the connection drops.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `KcpClientConnection` from `transport` and `client`.

members.name: Send
members.sig: INetworkTransportResult Send(byte[] data, int byteCount, int highLevelChannel)
members.desc: Sends the bytes on the KCP channel mapped from the game channel, writing the game channel into the first byte.

members.name: Disconnect
members.desc: Disconnects the KCP client.

members.name: OnDisconnected
members.desc: Raises `Disconnected`; called by the transport.

types.name: KcpClientWrapper
types.summary: Client side of the KCP transport: wraps a kcp2k `KcpClient` as an `ITransportClient`, so the game's networking can connect, tick and receive through it.

members.name: Logger
members.desc: NLog logger for this class.

members.name: settings
members.desc: The KCP tuning settings this client was made with.

members.name: client
members.desc: The kcp2k client; a `KcpClientNonAlloc` when `KcpSettings.NonAlloc` is on.

members.name: clientConnection
members.desc: Backing field for `Connection`.

members.name: processor
members.desc: The packet processor passed to the last `ProcessIncoming` call.

members.name: OutgoingQueueSize
members.desc: Number of messages waiting in kcp2k's send queue.

members.name: Connection
members.desc: The single `KcpClientConnection` to the server, used to send data.

members.name: OutgoingBytesTotal
members.desc: Total bytes sent, taken from the connection.

members.name: OutgoingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Total packets sent, taken from the connection.

members.name: IncomingPacketsTotal
members.desc: Count of data packets received and handed to the processor since this wrapper was made.

members.name: OnError
members.desc: Raised with the converted error whenever kcp2k reports one.

members.name: Approved
members.desc: Raised when kcp2k reports the connection to the server is up.

members.name: Disconnected
members.desc: Raised after kcp2k reports the connection closed, once the connection object has been told.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `KcpClientWrapper` from `transport` and `settings`.

members.name: ProcessIncoming
members.desc: Stores the processor for `HandleData` to use, then ticks kcp2k's incoming side. Always returns success.

members.name: ProcessOutgoing
members.desc: Ticks kcp2k's outgoing side, flushing queued sends. Always returns success.

members.name: Terminate
members.desc: Disconnects the kcp2k client. Always returns success.

members.name: Connect
members.desc: Starts connecting to the given IP and port, passing every tuning value from the `KcpSettings` to kcp2k.

members.name: HandleApproved
members.desc: kcp2k connected callback; raises `Approved`.

members.name: HandleDisconnected
members.desc: kcp2k disconnected callback; marks the connection disconnected and raises `Disconnected`.

members.name: HandleData

types.name: ClusterSettings
types.summary: How a cluster generator scatters child objects (such as crystals or mushrooms) around a point in a cave: how many, how they are rotated, offset and scaled, and whether they snap down onto a surface.

members.name: childCount
members.desc: Curve sampled at a random 0 to 1 value to pick how many children a cluster gets.

members.name: isRotationUnsplit
members.desc: True for a fully random rotation. False for random spin plus an up tilt between the min and max.

members.name: minimumUpRotation
members.desc: Smallest tilt in degrees when `isRotationUnsplit` is off.

members.name: maximumUpRotation
members.desc: Largest tilt in degrees when `isRotationUnsplit` is off.

members.name: offset
members.desc: Radius of the random offset around the parent (0.1 by default).

members.name: isEveningRandomPosition
members.desc: Pushes random offsets outwards (square root of each axis) for a more even spread.

members.name: verticalOffsetMultiplier
members.desc: Scales the random vertical offset. A negative value places children on a flat disc instead of in a sphere.

members.name: verticalOffset
members.desc: Fixed height added to every child's position.

members.name: isOffsetRestrictedToUpwards
members.desc: Keeps the random vertical offset positive (true by default).

members.name: isScaleRandom
members.desc: Scales each child by `randomScale` sampled at a random value.

members.name: randomScale
members.desc: Curve giving child scale when `isScaleRandom` is on.

members.name: isRaycastingFinal
members.desc: Raycasts down from the placed point and snaps the child to what it hits.

members.name: raycastingLayers
members.desc: Layers the snap raycast hits.

members.name: maxRaycastDistance
members.desc: Longest raycast used to snap children (2 by default).

members.name: isKinematic
members.desc: Makes each child's rigidbody kinematic after placing it.

members.name: ChildCount
members.desc: Curve sampled at a random 0 to 1 value to get how many children to spawn.

members.name: IsRotationUnsplit
members.desc: True gives each child a fully random rotation. False tilts it between `MinimumUpRotation` and `MaximumUpRotation` with random spins.

members.name: MinimumUpRotation
members.desc: Smallest tilt in degrees when `IsRotationUnsplit` is false.

members.name: MaximumUpRotation
members.desc: Largest tilt in degrees when `IsRotationUnsplit` is false.

members.name: Offset
members.desc: Radius of the random position offset around the parent.

members.name: IsEveningRandomPosition
members.desc: Pushes random offsets outward (square root of each axis), so children spread more evenly instead of bunching at the centre.

members.name: VerticalOffsetMultiplier
members.desc: Scales the random vertical offset. Negative values make the offset flat (a circle instead of a sphere).

members.name: VerticalOffset
members.desc: Added to the child's local height after the random offset.

members.name: IsOffsetRestrictedToUpwards
members.desc: Keeps the vertical offset positive, so children never sit below the centre.

members.name: IsScaleRandom
members.desc: Scales each child by `RandomScale` sampled at a random value.

members.name: RandomScale
members.desc: Scale curve used when `IsScaleRandom` is on.

members.name: IsRaycastingFinal
members.desc: Raycasts each child down onto `RaycastingLayers` after offsetting it, so it sits on a surface.

members.name: RaycastingLayers
members.desc: Layers the surface snap raycast hits.

members.name: MaxRaycastDistance
members.desc: How far the surface snap raycast reaches.

members.name: Position
members.desc: Parents the child and gives it a random rotation, position and scale using these settings.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `ClusterSettings` with default values.

types.name: SelectionCommandModule

types.name: ServerCommandModule
types.summary: Console module `server`: starts servers, proxies commands to other servers over their websocket console, and runs a spot-instance migration. Needs login, play mode and `server_owner`.

members.name: logger
members.desc: NLog logger for this module.

members.name: StartServerAsync
members.sig: static async void StartServerAsync(int serverId, bool isExternalLaunch = true, int port = 1757, bool isHeadless = true, bool isRunningLocally = true)
members.desc: `server start`: fetches a controllable server from the API and starts it, by default headless, launched externally on port 1757.

members.name: Proxy
members.sig: static async Task Proxy(int serverId, string proxiedCommand)
members.desc: `server proxy`: sends a console command to another server through its websocket console.

members.name: Migrate
members.desc: Server: `server migrate` locks joins, warns players, stops for migration, asks the API for a new allocation, saves, signals the new server and shuts down.

members.name: SaveWorld
members.desc: Saves the world instantly before a migration completes.

members.name: MigrateClientToNewInstance
members.desc: Placeholder for moving clients to the new server during migration; does nothing.

members.name: InformNewServerOfReadiness
members.desc: Sends `server mark-ready` to the new server over websocket during a migration; returns false on failure.

members.name: SendWebsocketMessage
members.sig: static async Task SendWebsocketMessage(int serverIdentifier, string message)
members.desc: Gets console connection details from the API, opens the server's websocket, authenticates with the token and sends one command request.

members.name: RequestMigrationFromWebApi
members.desc: Asks the Alta API for a migration allocation, retrying every 5 seconds until it gets one.

members.name: ShutdownPostMigration
members.desc: Quits the application after a migration with the given shutdown reason.

members.name: SendPlayerCommunications
members.desc: Sends migration warnings to all players now, a minute before and 10 seconds before termination.

types.name: IAction<TAgent>
types.summary: An AI action that can be started on a given agent type.

members.name: Start
members.desc: Starts the action on the agent and returns the running `IActiveAction`.

types.name: IAction
types.summary: One thing an AI creature can do, as used by the action decider. Its lists of target operations score the action, and `IAction<TAgent>.Start` begins it on an agent.

members.name: Name
members.desc: The action's name.

members.name: Multiplier
members.desc: Starting score for the action before operations are applied.

members.name: CalculateBaseRequired
members.desc: Operations that must pass without a target. A negative result rules the action out; others multiply its score.

members.name: CalculateBasePreferred
members.desc: Operations that add to or take from the action's score, without a target. Each result is weighted and summed.

members.name: CalculateTargetRequired
members.desc: Like `CalculateBaseRequired`, but checked against each possible target.

members.name: CalculateTargetPreferred
members.desc: Like `CalculateBasePreferred`, but scored against each possible target.

members.name: GeneralSettings
members.desc: Shared settings such as cancel priority and whether the action can be cancelled.

members.name: IsUsingTarget
members.desc: Whether the action is aimed at a target.

types.name: IActionDecider
types.summary: Picks an AI agent's actions from the targets it knows about. `ActionDecider<TAgent>` implements it; reach it through `Agent.GeneralActionDecider`.

members.name: PossibleTargets
members.desc: Targets the decider can currently choose between.

members.name: AddTarget
members.desc: Adds a possible target; returns whether it was added.

members.name: RemoveTarget
members.desc: Removes a possible target; returns whether it was there.

types.name: IActionSettings
types.summary: Settings every AI action has: its weighting and the rules for cancelling it. Implemented by `ActionComponent`.

members.name: name
members.desc: The action's name.

members.name: Multiplier
members.desc: Base weighting. `ActionComponent` can add a random extra on each read.

members.name: IsCancellable
members.desc: If false the action can't be cancelled once running.

members.name: CanCancelSelfWithSameTarget
members.desc: If false, picking this action again on the same target restarts it instead of cancelling and starting a new one.

members.name: MinimumCancelPriority
members.desc: While this action runs, only actions with at least this `CancelPriority` can replace it.

members.name: MinimumCancelWeighting
members.desc: While this action runs, a replacement must score above this weight.

members.name: CancelPriority
members.desc: This action is only considered if its priority is at least the running action's `MinimumCancelPriority`.

members.name: Used
members.desc: Fires each time the action starts.

members.name: HandleUsed
members.desc: Called each time the action starts. The first call initializes the `IAiHook` components, then `Used` fires.

types.name: IActionTarget
types.summary: A possible target for an AI action, with the weight it scored.

members.name: Target
members.desc: The target.

members.name: Weight
members.desc: How strongly the action wants this target.

types.name: IActiveAction
types.summary: A creature action that is running right now, started from an `IAction` for one agent. Raises `Finished` or `Cancelled` once, when it ends.

members.name: GeneralTopic
members.desc: The agent running the action.

members.name: Action
members.desc: The action this was started from.

members.name: IsFinished
members.desc: True once the action has finished or been cancelled.

members.name: EditorDuration

members.name: Finished
members.desc: Raised when the action completes normally.

members.name: Cancelled
members.desc: Raised when the action is cancelled.

members.name: Update

members.name: Cancel
members.desc: Stops the action early and raises `Cancelled` if it had not ended yet.

types.name: IAgent

members.name: ActiveAction

members.name: Collision

members.name: Director

members.name: HasTarget

members.name: HasWalker

members.name: NetworkAnimator

members.name: Rigidbody
members.desc: The creature's main rigidbody.

members.name: Target
members.desc: The target of the current action.

members.name: UpdateInterval
members.desc: Seconds between decision checks (default 0.1). Non-cancellable actions are not re-decided until they finish.

members.name: Walker
members.desc: The `Walker` component that moves the creature along paths.

members.name: AddTarget
members.desc: Server: offers a target to the action decider. Returns false if it is the agent itself, already added, or still on an ignore timer from `RemoveTarget`.

members.name: CancelCurrentAction

members.name: RemoveTarget
members.desc: Server: removes an added target. With a positive duration it instead ignores that target for that many seconds and returns false.

members.name: UseActionComponentSet
members.desc: Switches the set of possible actions the decider chooses from.

types.name: IInteractAgent

members.desc: The creature's interactor, used to grab the item it eats.

types.name: IReceiveImpulseFromCollision

types.name: ITarget

members.name: GetVelocity

members.name: maximum
members.desc: Backing field for `Maximum`. The base is capped to it and the value is clamped to it before the multiplier.

members.desc: Backing field for `NonBuffExtra`, a flat bonus that isn't from a buff.

members.name: Definition
members.desc: The `StatDefinition` this stat is for.

members.desc: True after a change until the next `OnChangedExternal`.

members.desc: Lower limit for `Base` plus extras. Raising it pushes `Base` up.

members.name: Maximum
members.desc: Upper limit for `Base` plus extras. Lowering it pulls `Base` down.

members.name: Base
members.desc: The stat's own value. Setting it clamps to `Minimum` and `Maximum`. This is the part that is saved.

members.name: Extra
members.desc: Flat bonus added to `Base`. Reading gives the buff extra plus `NonBuffExtra`; setting sets only the buff extra.

members.name: BuffMultiplier
members.desc: Multiplier from buffs. Part of `Multiplier`.

members.name: Multiplier
members.desc: Total multiplier, `BuffMultiplier` times `NonBuffMultiplier`.

members.name: NonBuffExtra
members.desc: Flat bonus that does not come from buffs.

members.name: NonBuffMultiplier
members.desc: Multiplier that does not come from buffs.

members.name: LastValue

members.name: AddTextToHistory
members.desc: Adds a non-empty entered line to history unless it repeats the last one.

members.name: OnDelete
members.desc: Deletes the character after the cursor, the next word with Ctrl, or the whole line with Shift.

members.name: OnLeftArrow
members.desc: Moves the cursor left one character, or to the word start with Ctrl.

members.name: OnRightArrow
members.desc: Moves the cursor right one character, or to the next word with Ctrl.

members.name: OnDownArrow
members.desc: Steps forward in history.

members.name: OnUpArrow
members.desc: Steps back in history.

types.name: ConsoleWindow
types.summary: Opens a native Windows console window for the game process and sends `Console` output to it. `WindowsServerConsole` creates one on its console thread.

members.name: oldOutput
members.desc: The `Console.Out` writer from before the redirect, restored on shutdown.

members.name: IsOpen
members.desc: True until the console is shut down or closed; the console thread loops while it's true.

members.name: STD_OUTPUT_HANDLE
members.desc: Win32 standard output handle ID (-11).

members.name: Initialize
members.desc: Creates the console, registers the close handler and points `Console` output at it.

members.name: Shutdown
members.desc: Restores the old output, frees the console and marks it closed.

members.name: SetTitle
members.desc: Sets the console window's title.

members.name: AttachConsole
members.desc: Win32 call to attach to another process's console. Not called here.

members.name: AllocConsole
members.desc: Win32 call that creates a console window for the process.

members.name: FreeConsole
members.desc: Win32 call that detaches the process from its console.

members.name: GetStdHandle
members.desc: Win32 call that gets a standard handle (here, standard output).

members.name: SetConsoleTitle
members.desc: Win32 call that sets the console's title.

members.name: SetConsoleCtrlHandler
members.desc: Win32 call that registers a handler for Ctrl+C and close events.

members.name: ConsoleCtrlCheck
members.desc: On close, logoff or shutdown of the console, marks it closed and quits the game with an expected shutdown reason.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Creates a `ConsoleWindow` with default values.

types.name: ConsoleWindow.HandlerRoutine
types.summary: Callback type for Win32 console control events (Ctrl+C, close, logoff, shutdown). Return true to mark the event handled.

members.name: .ctor
members.desc: Made by the compiler when you assign a method to this delegate; you don't call it directly.

members.name: Invoke
members.desc: Calls every method on this delegate with these arguments.

members.name: BeginInvoke
members.sig: virtual IAsyncResult BeginInvoke(ConsoleWindow.CtrlType CtrlType, AsyncCallback callback, object object)
members.desc: Starts the call on another thread; not supported in Unity, so use `Invoke`.

members.name: EndInvoke
members.desc: Waits for a call started with `BeginInvoke`; not supported in Unity.

types.name: ConsoleWindow.CtrlType
types.summary: Windows console control signals (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+Break, close, logoff, shutdown) passed to the console control handler.
